## Flagship Shipped Projects

### 1. Hire a Human (Flagship - Production Multi-Agent Hiring Platform)
- **URL:** https://hire-a-human.app/
- **Case Study:** https://www.sanskaragrawal.tech/projects/hire-a-human/
- **Architecture:** Hierarchical multi-agent system using LangGraph and LangChain
- **Pattern:** Supervisor agent coordinates 4 specialized sub-agents: resume screener, GitHub evaluator, LeetCode evaluator, voice interview agent
- **Verified Metrics:**
  - Technical screening time: ~15 minutes → under 1 minute
  - Voice agent time-to-first-audio (TTFA): approximately 700ms
  - Languages supported: 11
  - Real users validated: 44
  - HR recruiters validated: 6/6
  - Custom MCP servers built: 2 (GitHub evaluation + LeetCode evaluation)
- **Stack:** Python, LangGraph, LangChain, FastMCP, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, LiveKit Cloud, Twilio, Silero VAD, PostgreSQL, Docker

### 2. D2C AI Employee (E-Commerce Intelligence Platform)
- **URL:** https://d2caiemployee.netlify.app/login
- **Case Study:** https://www.sanskaragrawal.tech/projects/d2c-ai-employee/
- **Architecture:** Guardrail-gated LLM with 8 FastMCP tools, anti-hallucination SQL execution
- **Data Sources:** Shopify, Razorpay, Shiprocket, Meta Ads
- **Key Feature:** Every business metric is source-traceable — the agent executes real SQL queries, not LLM guesses
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, LangChain, FastMCP, Supabase (PostgreSQL), SQL, React, TypeScript

### 3. Offline Medical RAG System
- **Case Study:** https://www.sanskaragrawal.tech/projects/medical-rag/
- **Scale:** 2,000+ pages indexed, approximately 3,000 document chunks
- **Architecture:** 100% offline, ChromaDB vector store, local Mistral 7B embeddings via Ollama, 6 custom FastMCP servers, citation-backed retrieval
- **Key Feature:** Zero cloud API dependency — all inference and retrieval runs locally for data privacy
- **Stack:** Python, LangChain, ChromaDB, FastMCP, Ollama, Mistral 7B

### 4. Manufacturing AI Automation - GST Billing & OCR Pipeline
- **Case Study:** https://www.sanskaragrawal.tech/projects/manufacturing-automation/
- **Context:** Built during internship at Maurice Engineering Works
- **Architecture:** OCR pipeline for handwritten GST bills, FastAPI backend, Supabase database, React dashboard
- **Verified Metrics:**
  - Bills processed per day: approximately 50
  - OCR extraction accuracy: approximately 95%
  - Manual data entry saved: approximately 25 hours/week
  - Total accounting overhead saved: approximately 50 hours/week
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Supabase, React, TypeScript, REST APIs
